use_case: Clinical decision support (sepsis prediction) model: scores adult ED and inpatient encounters every 15 minutes and alerts the nurse when the score crosses the threshold, prompting the sepsis screening protocol
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor's predictive decision support intervention (machine learning model supplied with the certified EHR); version 2 since 2026-04-14
source_evidence: EV-076 (committee register); EV-078 (configuration, source attributes and version 2 upgrade record)
build_or_buy: Configure (vendor model; the system sets scope and threshold)
data_categories: Vital signs; laboratory results; nursing assessments; medications; date of birth (age) (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Nurse performs the sepsis screen and calls the provider; the physician decides on treatment; the alert never orders anything
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (input variable age); 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11) (developer duties; source attributes); HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA); FDA device status is the vendor determination (FD&C Act sec. 520(o)(1)(E))

bias_testing_status: Local validation and subgroup analysis on 41,200 encounters (2026-04-14 to 2026-07-31); two subgroup flags
monitoring: Monthly sensitivity, PPV, alert rate, and alert response by hospital and subgroup; full subgroup review quarterly
